# First Silicon

> Hardware, EE, embedded and semiconductor internships and co-ops from employer job boards, labeled by discipline, class year and citizenship flags. Updated daily. Focused on roles that first- and second-year students can apply to.

## Key pages
- [Open roles](https://firstsilicon.pages.dev/): filterable list of hardware internships and co-ops (discipline, class year, citizenship/export flags, term, location)
- [Programs calendar](https://firstsilicon.pages.dev/programs/): government and national-lab programs open before junior year, verified on official pages
- [Discipline guides](https://firstsilicon.pages.dev/disciplines/): what each hardware discipline involves and how to prepare
- [How it works](https://firstsilicon.pages.dev/how-it-works/): sources, update cadence, labeling rules and limits
- [Current data (JSON)](https://firstsilicon.pages.dev/data/jobs.json) and [run metadata](https://firstsilicon.pages.dev/data/meta.json)
- [About](https://firstsilicon.pages.dev/about/)

## Facts
- Sources: the public Greenhouse Job Board API (https://developers.greenhouse.io/job-board.html), Lever Postings API (https://github.com/lever/postings-api) and Ashby public job posting API (https://developers.ashbyhq.com/docs/public-job-posting-api).
- Employer job boards read: 87 (see https://firstsilicon.pages.dev/how-it-works/).
- The first automatic data run has not happened yet.
- Programs calendar: 7 programs, each verified on its official page (dates in https://firstsilicon.pages.dev/data/programs.json).
- Update cadence: once a day. Closed roles are removed on the next run.
- Labels are automatic pattern matches and can be wrong; the original employer posting is authoritative.
- Built by Mahir Patel, an electrical-engineering student at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

## How to cite
Cite as "First Silicon (firstsilicon.pages.dev), accessed <date>" with a link to the specific page. For a specific role, link to the employer's original posting, not to First Silicon.
